summary: Verified Yandex.Metrika counter 112190326 enablement (all 8 requested items) plus backend/admin regression. Frontend: window.ym is a function, https://mc.yandex.ru/metrika/tag.js loaded with HTTP 200, and window.ym.a[0] = ['112190326','init',{ssr:true, webvisor:true, clickmap:true, ecommerce:'dataLayer', accurateTrackBounce:true, trackLinks:true, referrer:'' (string, direct nav), url:'https://pc-build-engels.preview.emergentagent.com/'}] — every required key present and correct. GA4 confirmed NOT loaded (window.gtag undefined, window.dataLayer undefined, zero googletagmanager.com / google-analytics.com requests). Goals verified individually by diffing window.ym.a before/after each action: header-phone-link, contacts-phone-link, footer-phone-link each pushed exactly ['112190326','reachGoal','phone_click']; lead form submit ('Metrika QA' / +7 (993) 000-00-00) showed lead-form-success and pushed ['112190326','reachGoal','lead_submit']. Lead persisted — GET /api/leads with X-Admin-Token returned it (uuid id, status=new, no _id leak). Console clean: only a Chromium WebGL/GPU stall warning, zero analytics errors; unrelated mc.yandex.com/watch/44120344 hits come from the embedded Yandex Maps widget as expected. Backend regression: full pytest suite 18/18 passed (health, root, openapi, POST /api/leads all 6 services, 422 validation for empty/whitespace name, short phone, invalid service, GET /api/leads 401 without token, PATCH toggle + 404/422 cases). /admin loads, accepts token pktut2025admin, renders admin-leads-table with 17 rows including 'Metrika QA', and status toggle worked новая -> обработана -> новая via PATCH.

critical_code_review_comments: analytics.js: initAnalytics is guarded by an `initialized` flag and the snippet also de-dupes by scanning document.scripts for the tag.js src, so React StrictMode double-effect cannot double-load the counter — verified only one tag.js request on load.
trackGoal swallows exceptions and checks typeof window.ym === 'function' before calling, so analytics can never break the page — good.
Runtime-created <noscript> + innerHTML yields a text node, not an element subtree; this is a no-op path (see action item).
